name: Product Image & Alt Text Renamer
author: Syed Adnan

sections.description:
The Product Image & Alt Text Renamer plugin allows administrators to rename image filenames and edit Alt text directly in the WordPress admin area under the Media menu.

It updates both the server files and database (including postmeta and GUID) to maintain compatibility with WooCommerce products, which use attachment IDs.

Features include category filtering, search functionality, and secure admin-only access. This makes it easier to improve SEO and accessibility without breaking product image links.

Key Features

  • Rename image filenames without affecting WooCommerce product links.
  • Update Alt text for better SEO and accessibility.
  • Filter images by WooCommerce product categories.
  • Search images by filename.
  • Admin-only access with nonce security.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the product-image-alt-text-renamer folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Media > Rename Images in the admin menu.
  4. Use the category filter or search to find images, then edit filenames and Alt text as needed.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin affect site performance?

No. The plugin only runs in the WordPress admin area. Visitors to your site will not notice any changes.

Will it break my WooCommerce product images?

No. The plugin updates both the file and the database so product image links remain intact.

Can I rename images not linked to WooCommerce?

Yes. The plugin works with all Media Library images, but filtering is optimized for WooCommerce product categories.
